说明: 作文背诵网页的真题、分析、命题规律与预测、仿真练习（考研英语二 2010—2026）。真题原文和图表数据来自 Notion 英语二真题库（导入自真题 PDF；2025、2026 年题图数据来自公开整理版，已注明）。改完运行 python3 data/zuowen/check.py。

kind.multi: 调查比例（各项独立 / 多选）

predict.basis: 依据 2010—2026 年 17 套英语二真题统计。预测是按出题规律推断，不是内部消息；把握程度说的是「按过去的规律，这样准备最划算」。

fixed.t: 小作文：书信 / 邮件 / 通知，每题两个编号任务，约 100 词，不写地址。
fixed.basis: 17 年全部是两个编号任务、约 100 词。

fixed.t: 署名用题目指定的名字：2013 年起除 2015 年通知外都是 Li Ming。
fixed.basis: 2010—2012 年是 Zhang Wei；2015 年通知要求不写名字和校名。

fixed.t: 大作文：根据图表写，描述（解读）图表 + 给出评论，约 150 词。
fixed.basis: 17 年全部是图表作文；2023 年起措辞是 describe and interpret the chart。

small.basis: 2018—2026 年连续 9 年都是邮件；最近一次通知是 2015 年。
small.prep: 邮件和书信格式一样：称呼、开头说目的、正文、结尾、落款。

small.t: 写给朋友或留学生，语气友好
small.prep: 主攻友好语气；正式信的称呼和结尾（Dear Professor … / Yours sincerely）也要会一套。

small.t: 任务是「介绍 + 邀请」或「介绍 + 建议 / 征求意见」
small.basis: 「介绍告知」17 年里 10 年都有，2020—2026 年占 5 年；邀请类 6 年；建议 6 年；请求征求 4 年。
small.prep: 介绍细节、邀请参加、建议理由、请求与语气四个板块的功能句先背。

small.t: 话题和中国文化、传统或在中国旅行有关
small.prep: 准备一组「中国文化」用词：traditional, culture / cultural, history / historical, festival, local food。

small.t: 道歉、投诉、祝贺这类语气动作
small.prep: 各背一句开头就够：I am writing to apologize for … / complain about … / congratulate you on …

big.t: 调查类百分比图（各项独立 / 可以多选）
big.prep: 背熟「调查图模板」和多选句型：X% of the respondents …，不写合计、不写 accounts for … of the total。
背熟「动态图模板」；会写起点、终点、转折点。
「静态图模板」：accounts for the largest share, followed by …

big.basis: 表格只在 2012 年考过；两点对比 2011、2019 年各一次。
big.prep: 知道怎么读：表格先分清横纵表头；两点对比写每一类的变化。

big.t: 话题偏健康、教育、养老、家庭这类社会生活
big.basis: 2021 锻炼、2023 健康素养、2024 劳动课、2025 老年人休闲、2026 儿童户外活动。
big.prep: 评论素材准备：健康意识提高、教育改革、老龄化、家庭陪伴、科技带来的便利。

plan: 第 1 层先把「书信通用模板」「调查图模板」背熟——对应最可能的小作文（写给朋友的邮件）和大作文（调查类百分比图）。
再背「动态图模板」，防多年份变化图；「静态图模板」用于饼图。
第 2 层先背：介绍细节、邀请参加、建议理由三个板块，以及图表板块里的多选句型。
道歉、投诉、祝贺各背一句开头就够。
每种题型至少限时写一篇真题、一篇仿真题，写完复制给 AI 批改。

small.dir:
You have just come back from the U.S. as a member of a Sino-American cultural exchange program. Write a letter to your American colleague to
1) express your thanks for his/her warm reception;
2) welcome him/her to visit China in due course.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 你作为中美文化交流项目的成员刚从美国回来。给美国同事写一封信：1）感谢他/她的热情接待；2）欢迎他/她适时来中国访问。约 100 词，署名 Zhang Wei，不写地址。
small.who: 中美文化交流项目成员，刚从美国回来
small.tone: 礼貌友好：是同事，不是很熟的朋友，别太随意

tasks.en: express your thanks for his/her warm reception
tasks.how: 说清楚感谢什么：接待、安排的活动、陪你参观……再说一句这次交流的收获

tasks.en: welcome him/her to visit China in due course
tasks.how: 表示欢迎 + 你可以做什么（当向导、安排参观）+ 期待见面

small.open: I am writing to express my thanks for your warm reception during my stay in the U.S.
traps: 署名是 Zhang Wei，不是 Li Ming（2010–2012 年都是 Zhang Wei）
his/her：不知道对方性别，正文直接用 you
第二个任务是「欢迎来访」，不是邀请参加某个活动；in due course = 在合适的时候

small.dir:
Suppose your cousin Li Ming has just been admitted to a university. Write him/her a letter to
1) congratulate him/her, and
2) give him/her suggestions on how to get prepared for university life.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你的表亲 Li Ming 刚被大学录取。给他/她写信：1）表示祝贺；2）就怎样为大学生活做准备给出建议。约 100 词，署名 Zhang Wei。
small.who: Li Ming 的表哥 / 表姐

tasks.how: 第一句就祝贺：Congratulations on being admitted to …

tasks.en: give him/her suggestions on how to get prepared for university life
tasks.zh: 建议怎样为大学生活做准备
tasks.how: 两条建议 + 各一个理由（学习、生活、交友任选两样）

small.open: I am writing to congratulate you on being admitted to the university.
traps: 收信人叫 Li Ming，署名是 Zhang Wei——别写反
建议只围绕「怎样准备大学生活」，两条就够，不要写成学习方法大全
advice 不可数；suggest 后面不接 sb. to do

small.dir:
Suppose you have found something wrong with the electronic dictionary that you bought from an online store the other day. Write an email to the customer service center to
1) make a complaint, and
2) demand a prompt solution.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你前几天在网店买的电子词典有问题。给客服中心写邮件：1）投诉；2）要求尽快解决。约 100 词，署名 Zhang Wei。

tasks.how: 写清楚买了什么、什么时候买的、具体什么问题（屏幕、按键、发音……）
明确提出换货、退款或维修，并给一个期限

small.open: I am writing to complain about the electronic dictionary that I bought from your online store last week.
traps: 写给机构：称呼 Dear Sir or Madam，结尾 Yours sincerely
问题要具体，不能只说 It is bad
demand 是「要求」：要说清楚你要什么解决办法、什么时候之前

small.dir:
Suppose your class is to hold a charity sale for kids in need of help. Write your classmates an email to
1) inform them about the details, and
2) encourage them to participate.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你们班要为需要帮助的孩子办一场慈善义卖。给同学写邮件：1）告知详细情况；2）鼓励大家参加。

tasks.how: 时间、地点、卖什么、钱用来做什么，至少写三样
说意义（帮助孩子）+ 怎么参与（捐东西、当志愿者）

small.open: I am writing to tell you about the charity sale our class will hold for kids in need of help.
traps: details 至少写时间、地点、内容
鼓励要给理由，不要只喊 Come on
收入去向写清楚：All the money will go to …

small.dir:
Suppose you are going to study abroad and share an apartment with John, a local student. Write him an email to
1) tell him about your living habits, and
2) ask for advice about living there.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你要出国留学，和当地学生 John 合租公寓。给他写邮件：1）介绍你的生活习惯；2）就在当地生活向他请教。
small.to: 未来的室友 John（当地学生）

tasks.en: tell him about your living habits
tasks.how: 作息、爱好、卫生习惯，用一般现在时：I usually get up at 7 a.m.

tasks.en: ask for advice about living there
tasks.zh: 请他给在当地生活的建议
tasks.how: 用问句请教：Could you give me some advice on …?

small.open: I am writing to tell you about my living habits before we start to share the apartment.
traps: 生活习惯用一般现在时
第二个任务是请教，不是给建议
说完习惯可以加一句「希望不打扰你」，显得礼貌

small.dir:
Suppose your university is going to host a summer camp for high school students. Write a notice to
1) briefly introduce the camp activities, and
2) call for volunteers.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your name or the name of your university.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你校要为高中生办夏令营。写一则通知：1）简要介绍夏令营的活动；2）招募志愿者。不写个人名字和学校名称。
small.sign: 不署个人名，右下角写发布部门（如 The Students' Union）

tasks.how: 时间、地点、两三项活动，briefly：不要展开太多
要求、职责、报名方式和截止时间

small.open: In order to help high school students learn about university life, our university will hold a summer camp this July.
traps: 格式：标题 NOTICE 居中，正文不写 Dear，右下角写发布者
不能写学校名字和自己的名字
招募要写清楚要求和怎么报名

small.dir:
Suppose you won a translation contest and your friend, Jack, wrote an email to congratulate you and ask for advice on translation. Write him a reply to
1) thank him, and
2) give your advice.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你在翻译比赛中获奖，朋友 Jack 写邮件祝贺你，并请教翻译方面的建议。给他回信：1）表示感谢；2）给出建议。

tasks.how: 开头就回应他的来信：Thank you for your congratulations …
两条：多读多练、了解文化背景、用好词典……

small.open: Thank you very much for your congratulations on my winning the translation contest.
traps: 这是回信：开头先回应对方的来信
第一个任务是感谢，不是祝贺——别写成 Congratulations
建议要和翻译有关，不要泛泛地谈学习

small.dir:
Suppose you are invited by Professor Williams to give a presentation about Chinese culture to a group of international students. Write a reply to
1) accept the invitation, and
2) introduce the key points of your presentation.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设 Williams 教授邀请你给一群留学生做一个关于中国文化的报告。写回信：1）接受邀请；2）介绍报告的要点。

tasks.how: 先感谢邀请，再明确说接受

tasks.en: introduce the key points of your presentation
tasks.how: 两三个要点：传统节日、饮食、书法……用 First / Second / Finally

small.open: Thank you for inviting me to give a presentation about Chinese culture. I am glad to accept your invitation.
traps: 称呼 Dear Professor Williams，结尾 Yours sincerely
要点列两三个就好，不要写成整篇报告
presentation 拼写；Chinese culture 里的 culture 是名词

small.dir:
Suppose you have to cancel your travel plan and will not be able to visit Professor Smith. Write him an email to
1) apologize and explain the situation, and
2) suggest a future meeting.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你不得不取消旅行计划，不能去拜访 Smith 教授了。给他写邮件：1）道歉并说明情况；2）提议以后见面。
small.who: 原本要去拜访教授的学生

tasks.how: 两个动作：先道歉，再说具体原因
给一两个具体时间或方式（下个月 / 线上），并问对方是否方便

small.open: I am writing to apologize for not being able to visit you as planned.
traps: 任务 1 有两个动作：道歉 + 解释，原因要具体
改期要给具体时间或方式
语气正式：不用 Hi，不用缩写

small.dir:
Suppose Professor Smith asked you to plan a debate on the theme of city traffic. Write him an email to
1) suggest a specific topic with your reasons, and
2) tell him about your arrangements.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设 Smith 教授请你策划一场以城市交通为主题的辩论。给他写邮件：1）提出一个具体的辩题并说明理由；2）告诉他你的安排。

tasks.en: suggest a specific topic with your reasons
tasks.zh: 提出一个具体辩题，并说明理由
tasks.how: 两个动作：辩题要具体（比如 Should private cars be limited in big cities?）+ 理由
时间、地点、参加者、流程，用将来时 will

small.open: I am writing to suggest a topic for the debate on city traffic.
traps: 辩题要具体，不能只写 city traffic
with your reasons：理由不能漏
安排用将来时：The debate will be held …

small.dir:
Suppose you are planning a tour of a historical site for a group of international students. Write them an email to
1) tell them about the site, and
2) give them some tips for the tour.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name, use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你在为一群留学生策划一次历史古迹游览。给他们写邮件：1）介绍这处古迹；2）给出游览提示。

tasks.how: 名字、历史、特色，再加时间地点

tasks.en: give them some tips for the tour
tasks.how: 穿着、要带的东西、注意事项，用 should / Please remember to …

small.open: I am writing to tell you about the historical site we are going to visit next week.
traps: 写给一群人：称呼 Dear friends / Dear all
每句都要有动词：The Great Wall is very long.（不能写 the Great Wall very long）
提示用 should / Please remember to + 动词原形

small.dir:
Suppose you are organizing an online meeting. Write an e-mail to Jack, an international student, to
1) invite him to participate, and
2) tell him the details.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你在组织一场线上会议。给留学生 Jack 写邮件：1）邀请他参加；2）告诉他具体安排。

tasks.how: 邀请 + 一个理由
主题、时间、平台、怎么加入

small.open: I am writing to invite you to take part in an online meeting that I am organizing.
traps: participate 后面要加 in
线上会议的细节：主题、时间、平台、会议号
at + 钟点、on + 星期，别混用

small.dir:
Suppose you are planning a campus food festival. Write an email to the international students in your university to
1) introduce the food festival, and
2) invite them to participate.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你在筹办校园美食节。给本校留学生写邮件：1）介绍美食节；2）邀请他们参加。

tasks.how: 时间、地点、有哪些食物和活动
邀请 + 理由 + 怎么参加

small.open: I am writing to tell you about the food festival on our campus and invite you to join us.
traps: will be held，不写 will be hold
food 一般不加 s：many kinds of delicious food
写给一群人：Dear international students / Dear friends

small.dir:
An art exhibition and a robot show are to be held on Sunday, and your friend David asks you which one he should go to. Write him an email to
1) make a suggestion, and
2) give your reason(s).
Write your answer in about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 周日有一场艺术展和一场机器人展，朋友 David 问你该去哪个。给他写邮件：1）提出建议；2）说明理由。

tasks.how: 明确只推荐一个
一两条，要和他的兴趣、展览特点对得上

small.open: I suggest that you go to the robot show on Sunday.
traps: 只推荐一个，别两个都推荐
reason(s)：一两条，要具体
suggest that you (should) go，不写 suggest you to go

small.dir:
Suppose you and Jack are going to do a survey on the protection of old houses in an ancient town. Write him an email to
1) put forward your plan, and
2) ask for his opinion.
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你和 Jack 要就古镇老房子的保护做一次调查。给他写邮件：1）提出你的计划；2）征求他的意见。

tasks.how: 时间、地点、怎么调查（采访居民、拍照、发问卷）、怎么分工
用问句结尾：What do you think of my plan?

small.open: I am writing to tell you about my plan for our survey on the protection of old houses.
traps: 计划分步骤写：First … Then … Finally …
protection 是名词，protect 是动词
征求意见用问句，语气别像命令

small.dir:
Suppose you are planning a short play based on a classic Chinese novel. Write your friend John an email to
1) introduce the play, and
2) invite him to take part in it.
Write your answer in about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设你在根据一部中国古典小说排一出短剧。给朋友 John 写邮件：1）介绍这出剧；2）邀请他参演。

tasks.how: 根据哪部小说、讲什么、什么时候在哪演

tasks.en: invite him to take part in it
tasks.how: 演什么角色、为什么适合他、怎么回复你

small.open: I am writing to tell you about a short play I am planning, which is based on a classic Chinese novel.
traps: 书名首字母大写：Journey to the West
take part in 的 in 不能漏
邀请要说他演什么、为什么适合，再说怎么回复

small.dir:
Suppose your friend Jack has shared with you a video of his family's travel in China. Write an email to tell him
1) how you feel about the video, and
2) your wish to learn more about their travel.
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in your email. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
small.zh: 假设朋友 Jack 和你分享了他一家在中国旅行的视频。给他写邮件，告诉他：1）你看了视频的感受；2）你想进一步了解他们这次旅行。

tasks.en: how you feel about the video
tasks.how: 具体说喜欢哪个画面、为什么

tasks.en: your wish to learn more about their travel
tasks.zh: 你想进一步了解他们的旅行
tasks.how: 表达愿望 + 提一两个问题：Where did you go? What impressed you most?

small.open: Thank you for sharing the video of your family's trip in China with me. I really enjoyed it.
traps: 感受要具体，不只说 It is good
第二个任务可以用问句表达想了解的内容
一次旅行用 trip；travel 一般不可数

big.dir:
In this section, you are asked to write an essay based on the following chart. In your writing, you should
1) interpret the chart and
2) give your comments.
You should write at least 150 words.
Write your essay on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
big.zh: 根据下面的图表写一篇短文：1）解读图表；2）给出评论。至少 150 词。
big.title: Mobile-phone subscriptions (2000-2008)
big.who: 全球：发展中国家 / 发达国家
facts: 两组都在上升，但速度差很多：发展中国家从约 0.4 十亿涨到约 4 十亿，约 10 倍
发达国家只从约 0.7 涨到约 1.0，增长平缓
2003 年前后发展中国家反超，2008 年约为发达国家的 4 倍
sents: The number of mobile-phone subscriptions in developing countries rose sharply from about 0.4 billion in 2000 to about 4 billion in 2008.
In contrast, the figure in developed countries increased only slightly, from about 0.7 billion to about 1 billion.
traps: 数值是按柱高估读的，写 about / nearly
单位是 billion（十亿）：4 billion，不写 4 billions
两组比较用 while / in contrast；这一年要求至少 150 词
angle: 原因：发展中国家经济发展、手机变便宜、网络覆盖扩大；发达国家早已普及
意义：手机让沟通和获取信息更方便
展望：增长还会继续，也要注意过度使用

big.dir:
Write an essay based on the following chart. In your writing, you should
1) interpret the chart and
2) give your comments.
You should write at least 150 words.
Write your essay on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
big.zh: 根据下面的图表写一篇短文：1）解读图表；2）给出评论。至少 150 词。
big.title: 2008、2009 年国内轿车市场部分品牌市场份额
facts: 国产品牌上升：约 26% → 约 32%，2009 年反超日系成为第一
日系品牌明显下降：约 35% → 约 26%
美系品牌基本持平：约 12% → 约 13%
sents: The market share of domestic brands rose from about 26% in 2008 to about 32% in 2009, overtaking that of Japanese brands.
Meanwhile, the share of Japanese brands dropped from about 35% to about 26%.
traps: 只是「部分品牌」，三项加起来不是 100%，不能说合计
两年对比：写每一类的变化方向 + 排名变化
份额变化可以说 percentage points（国产品牌上升了约 6 个百分点）
angle: 原因：国产车质量提高、价格有优势、政策支持
意义：民族品牌崛起
建议：国产品牌继续创新、提升品质

big.title: 某公司员工工作满意度调查
facts: 41~50 岁组最不满意：不满意 64.0%，满意 0.0%
>50 岁组最满意：满意 40.0%，不满意只有 10.0%
≤40 岁组有一半（50.0%）说不清楚
满意度不随年龄单调变化——不能写「年龄越大越满意」
sents: None of the employees aged 41 to 50 are satisfied with their jobs, and as many as 64% of them are dissatisfied.
By contrast, 40% of the employees over 50 are satisfied, while only 10% are not.
traps: 先分清横表头（满意度）和纵表头（年龄组）再比较
不能概括成「年龄越大越满意」
0.0% 用 none / no one 表达更自然
angle: 原因：41~50 岁压力大（家庭、晋升）；年轻人还在适应；50 岁以上更稳定、期望更低
建议：公司多关注中年员工，改善待遇和晋升机会

这是不同年级的比较，不是同一批学生逐年变化；四个比例各自独立，加起来没有意义

big.title: 20 年间中国城镇人口与乡村人口变化
facts: 城镇人口持续上升：300 → 458 → 666（百万），20 年里翻了一倍多
乡村人口持续下降：834 → 807 → 674（百万）
两者差距越来越小，2010 年已接近（666 对 674），但城镇还没有超过乡村
sents: The urban population of China rose steadily from 300 million in 1990 to 666 million in 2010.
In contrast, the rural population dropped from 834 million to 674 million during the same period.
traps: 单位是百万：300 million，不写 300 millions
两组反向变化，用 in contrast
2010 年城镇人口仍略少于乡村，不能说已经超过
angle: 原因：城镇化、城市就业机会多、教育医疗条件好
影响：城市拥挤、农村劳动力减少
建议：发展乡村经济、城乡协调发展

Dining together, transportation and other expenses each make up 20%.

gifts 可数要加 s
angle: 原因：春节重视亲情和人情往来、生活水平提高

facts: 欣赏风景（37%）和缓解压力（33%）是两大目的，合计 70%
广交朋友 9%、培养独立能力 6%，占比很小
其他 15%；各项合计 100%
sents: Enjoying the scenery and relieving pressure are the two main purposes of travel, accounting for 37% and 33% respectively.
By contrast, only 6% of the students travel to become more independent.
traps: respectively 放句末，按前面的顺序对应
不用逐个复述所有数字，抓两大项 + 最小项
relieve pressure（缓解压力），记不住就写 relax
angle: 原因：学习压力大、生活水平提高、交通方便
评论：旅游有益身心，也能锻炼独立能力

big.title: 2013—2015 年我国博物馆数量和参观人数
facts: 博物馆数量逐年增加：4165 → 4510 → 4697 家
参观人次也逐年增加：约 6.38 亿 → 7.18 亿 → 7.81 亿
两组单位不同，只能分别描述，不能比大小
sents: The number of museums in China increased from 4,165 in 2013 to 4,697 in 2015.
Meanwhile, the number of museum visits rose from about 638 million to about 781 million.
traps: 参观人数的单位是「十万人次」：6378 个十万 = 约 6.38 亿 = about 638 million
两组单位不同，不能写 visitors are more than museums
visits（人次）和 visitors（人）不一样，写 the number of visits 更准
angle: 原因：政府投入、博物馆免费开放、人们的文化需求提高
意义：传承文化、丰富精神生活
建议：继续建设，提升展览质量
big.note: 原图把两组数据画在一起；这里按单位分成两张图，因为两组单位不同，不能放在同一个刻度上比。

特色 = special features / unique dishes
angle: 原因：生活水平提高，从「吃饱」到「吃好」，更看重体验
建议：餐厅要突出特色、提升服务

facts: 独自锻炼最多：54.3%，其次和朋友一起 47.7%
和家人一起（23.9%）、团体活动（15.8%）明显较少
四项相加 141.7%，超过 100%：可以多选，不能说「合计」或「占全部的一半」
sents: As many as 54.3% of the respondents choose to exercise alone, followed by those who exercise with friends (47.7%).
By contrast, only 15.8% take part in group activities.

exercise alone / with friends / with family / in group activities

big.title: 2018~2020 年我国快递业务量变动情况
facts: 总体快递量逐年上升：51 → 64 → 83（十亿件）
农村快递量也上升：12 → 15 → 30，2020 年翻了一倍
农村是总体的一部分，两组不能相加
sents: The total number of express deliveries in China rose from 51 billion in 2018 to 83 billion in 2020.
In rural areas, the figure doubled from 15 billion in 2019 to 30 billion in 2020.
traps: 农村快递量包含在总体里，不能把 51 和 12 加起来
单位十亿件 = billion：51 billion parcels
2020 年农村增长特别快，是亮点
angle: 原因：网购普及、物流网络进入农村、乡村振兴政策
意义：方便农村生活，帮农产品卖出去

Write an essay based on the following chart. In your essay, you should

2) give your comments.
Write your answer in about 150 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
big.zh: 根据下面的图表写一篇短文：1）描述并解读图表；2）给出评论。约 150 词。
big.title: 2012—2021 年我国居民健康素养水平
big.who: 全国居民（15—69 岁城乡居民）
facts: 持续上升：从 8.80% 到 25.40%，10 年里接近原来的 3 倍
前几年涨得慢（2012—2015 年只涨了约 1.5 个百分点），2016 年以后明显加快
到 2021 年也只有约四分之一的人具备基本健康素养，还有很大提升空间
sents: The health literacy level of Chinese residents rose steadily from 8.80% in 2012 to 25.40% in 2021.
However, this means that only about a quarter of residents had basic health literacy in 2021.
traps: 不要逐年复述 10 个数字，只报起点、终点和加快的拐点
健康素养水平 = 具备基本健康素养的人所占比例，不是「健康的人」的比例
要求 describe and interpret：要解释这个指标是什么意思
angle: 原因：健康知识普及、网上信息多、生活水平提高、人们更重视健康
建议：继续推广健康教育，个人主动学习健康知识
big.note: 题目附注：健康素养指个人获取和理解基本健康信息和服务，并运用这些信息和服务做出正确决策、维护和促进自身健康的能力；健康素养水平指具备基本健康素养的人在总人群（15—69 岁城乡居民）中所占的比例。

facts: 看电视最多：90.8%，散步 68.3% 次之

建议：社区开设老年大学、组织活动，家人多陪伴
big.note: 原卷标题和图形样式没有转写下来，数据来自公开整理版（新东方在线 2025 年 1 月整理），不是官方原卷；早期转载版第二项有写成 86.3% 或「看书」的，这里不采用。

mocks.dir:
Suppose you are organizing a traditional Chinese tea culture workshop on your campus. Write an email to Jack, an international student, to

2) invite him to join it.
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
mocks.zh: 假设你在校园里组织一场中国传统茶文化体验活动。给留学生 Jack 写邮件：1）介绍这个活动；2）邀请他参加。

tasks.how: 时间、地点、内容（泡茶、品茶、讲茶的历史）
理由 + 怎么报名

mocks.open: I am writing to invite you to a traditional Chinese tea culture workshop on our campus.
traps: workshop（体验活动）记不住就写 activity
介绍要有时间、地点、内容三样
邀请要说理由和怎么报名
mocks.aim: 介绍 + 邀请 · 写给留学生 · 中国文化

the Spring Festival 首字母大写、前面加 the

1) thank her and tell her how you feel about the book, and

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
mocks.zh: 假设朋友 Lucy 送你一本介绍她家乡历史的书。给她写邮件：1）感谢她，并谈谈你对这本书的感受；2）邀请她来你的家乡。

tasks.en: thank her and tell her how you feel about the book
tasks.how: 两个动作：先感谢，再说哪部分最有意思、为什么

tasks.en: invite her to visit your hometown
tasks.how: 什么时候来、可以去哪、做什么

mocks.open: Thank you very much for the book about the history of your hometown.
traps: 任务 1 有两个动作：感谢 + 谈感受，别漏
感受要具体
邀请说时间、地点和可以做的事
mocks.aim: 一个编号里两个动作 · 感谢 + 感受 + 邀请

mocks.dir:
Suppose you cannot attend Professor Brown's lecture next Monday as planned. Write him an email to
1) apologize and explain the reason, and
2) ask whether you could get the lecture notes.
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
mocks.zh: 假设你下周一不能按计划去听 Brown 教授的讲座。给他写邮件：1）道歉并说明原因；2）问能不能拿到讲座笔记（讲义）。

tasks.how: 两个动作：道歉 + 具体原因

tasks.en: ask whether you could get the lecture notes
tasks.zh: 问能不能拿到讲座笔记
tasks.how: 礼貌请求：Could you please …? / I would appreciate it if …

mocks.open: I am writing to apologize for not being able to attend your lecture next Monday as planned.
traps: Dear Professor Brown，结尾 Yours sincerely
原因要具体，语气诚恳
请求用礼貌问句，不用命令语气
mocks.aim: 正式信 · 道歉 + 请求（考得少，但要会）

mocks.dir:
Suppose your university is going to hold an international culture festival. Write a notice to
1) briefly introduce the festival, and
2) call for student volunteers.
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name or the name of your university. (10 points)
mocks.zh: 假设你校要办国际文化节。写一则通知：1）简要介绍文化节；2）招募学生志愿者。不写个人名和校名。
mocks.sign: 不署个人名，右下角写发布部门

tasks.how: 时间、地点、两三项活动
要求、职责、报名方式和截止时间

mocks.open: In order to promote cultural exchange, our university will hold an international culture festival next month.
traps: NOTICE 标题居中，正文不写 Dear，右下角写发布者
不写个人名和学校名
招募写要求和报名方式
mocks.aim: 通知格式（2015 年考过一次）

1) describe and interpret the chart, and
2) give your comments.
Write your answer in about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)
mocks.zh: 根据下面的图表写一篇短文：1）描述并解读图表；2）给出评论。约 150 词。
mocks.title: 某市居民周末休闲方式调查（可多选）
facts: 看短视频最多：72.4%，逛公园 58.6% 次之
参观博物馆最少：18.7%；各项相加超过 100%，是多选
sents: Watching short videos is the most popular weekend activity, chosen by 72.4% of the respondents, followed by visiting parks (58.6%).
traps: 多选：不写合计
short videos（短视频）
评论可以讨论：短视频受欢迎，读书和参观博物馆却少
angle: 原因：手机方便、内容丰富；公园免费、离家近
建议：合理安排休闲时间，多读书、多运动
mocks.aim: 调查类多选（2024–2026 连续三年）

2) give your comments.

mocks.title: 2018—2024 年某市共享单车日均骑行量（单位：万人次）
facts: 总体上升：32 → 83 万人次，增长一倍多
2020 年略有下降（41 → 38），之后快速回升
2024 年最高：83 万人次
sents: The average daily number of shared-bike rides rose from 320,000 in 2018 to 830,000 in 2024, despite a slight drop in 2020.
traps: 有回落要写出来：dropped slightly in 2020
过去的数据用过去时
angle: 原因：方便、环保、政府鼓励绿色出行
问题：乱停乱放；建议：规范管理
mocks.aim: 动态图 · 中间有回落

mocks.title: 某高校学生每月生活费支出构成
facts: 饮食占比最大：45%，接近一半
娱乐社交 18%、网购 15%
学习用品只占 12%，其他 10%；合计 100%
sents: Food accounts for the largest share of students' monthly spending, at 45%, nearly half of the total.
traps: 合计 100% 才能用 of the total
学习用品占比低，可以作为评论点
spending 不可数
angle: 原因：吃饭是基本需求；社交、网购方便
建议：理性消费、做好预算

mocks.zh: 根据下面的图表写一篇短文：1）描述并解读图表；2）给出评论。约 150 词。
mocks.title: 某市居民获取新闻的主要途径（2015 年与 2025 年）
facts: 手机应用大幅上升：28.7% → 63.9%，成为第一
sents: The share of people getting news from mobile apps rose sharply from 28.7% in 2015 to 63.9% in 2025, while that of TV fell from 46.2% to 21.5%.
traps: 两个时间点：写每类的变化 + 排名变化
百分比的差用 percentage points：手机应用上升了 35.2 个百分点
mobile apps 用复数
angle: 原因：智能手机普及、新闻更新快
影响：要学会辨别信息真假
